lines.text: The LORD tells Eliphaz to take seven bulls and seven rams to Job and sacrifice a burnt offering.
Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar do as the LORD told them, and the LORD accepts Job's prayer.
The LORD doubles Job's former possessions, and each visitor gives him a piece of silver and a jar of oil.
Job owns 7,000 sheep and 6,000 camels, has seven sons and three daughters, and names his first daughter Jemimah.
Job lives 140 years after this, sees his children to the fourth generation, and dies old and full of years.
